description: Fast-loop iteration 1 critical positions: the losing move of each v11-vs-v0 loss and the oracle-verified perfect move instead. The patched engine must play an expected move on every position (fl1-g9-ply11 is a known xfail — the q-vs-visits gap, H1's territory — see its note).

positions.source: fast-v11-vs-v0-iter1.json game 9, ply 11 (v11 White, lost in 25 plies)
positions.note: Oracle-verified losing move (walkback, seeds 0/1/2): (6,6) loses 3/3; (11,6) wins 3/3, (10,7) and (11,9) draw 3/3. Raw q: (6,6) -0.105 (30 visits) vs (11,6) +0.024 (4 visits) — but raw q is the OPPONENT's value (see iter-9.md §1.0); correctly signed, q prefers the LOSER (our-q +0.105 vs -0.024), so the search does NOT know the right move here. [coordinator correction, iter-11.md §9]

Terminal-case subtree lines, not the net (net gap 0.028 x a=0.125 = 0.004). v11 was WINNING at ply 31 (oracle win 3/3) and threw it here. [coordinator correction, iter-11.md §9]
